test_title: RRB NTPC CBT-I Official Paper (Held On: 25 Jan 2021 Shift 1)
subject: general
question:
From his house, Kamal drives 10 km in the north-west direction and then 10 km in the south-west direction. After that, he drives 10 km in the south-east direction. Finally, he turns towards his house and drives further.

In which of the directions given below is he most likely to be driving?
solution:
According to the given information:-

1) Kamal drives 10 km in the north-west direction and then 10 km in the south-west direction.

2) After that, he drives 10 km in the south-east direction.

 
• Finally, he turns towards his house and drives further.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/dfd8373bd3e96e5de790b68c1ae6e5788d1fc0120faf58293c83d9a490a59630.png] 

∴ Here, Kamal is driving finally towards 'North-east'.

Hence, the correct answer is **"North-east".**
